gates.purpose: Guarantee the input to Pack AA is exactly the frozen, unmodified Pack A product before any Pythia step runs.
checks: sha256sum(frozen_artifact) == config.pack_a.frozen_artifact_sha256
sha256sum(input_lhe) == config.pack_a.input_lhe_sha256
LHE contains only PDG 9000006 as the LLP with status marking it stable (no decay vertex)
LHE hard-process identity matches ZERO_JET_ONLY g g > H > h2 h2
gates.acceptance_criteria: All four checks pass exactly; no tolerance on hash checks.
gates.failure_status: exit 2, run aborted before any Pythia invocation

gates.purpose: Guarantee the declared config is internally consistent and physically well-formed before any generation is attempted.
checks: exactly one canonical lifetime representation, or multiple mutually consistent within 0.1% relative tolerance
sum(branching_ratio) == 1.0 +/- 1e-6, unless allow_partial_width is explicitly true with a named placeholder policy
every daughters PDG exists in Pythia's particle database
every channel's daughter pole-mass sum <= llp.mass_GeV
no pythia.settings entries touch matching/merging or hard-process ISR/FSR
no duplicate decay ownership (Pack A LHE marks h2 stable; config does not attempt to pre-decay h2 outside Pythia)
output.directory does not already exist
gates.acceptance_criteria: All checks pass; any single failure blocks the run.

gates.purpose: Confirm, on a single event, that Pythia and only Pythia performs the h2 decay and that the event remains structurally sound.
checks: h2 enters Pythia's event record with mayDecay=true and status matching a resonance/particle about to decay
h2 decays exactly once, only inside Pythia (no decay vertex present pre-Pythia)
declared daughters (per config) appear as direct children of the h2 decay vertex
a decay vertex with finite spacetime coordinates exists on the h2 line
proper-time / proper-length info is populated and non-degenerate
output event parses cleanly under the chosen HepMC2 reader
gates.acceptance_criteria: All six checks pass for the single test event.

gates.purpose: Confirm determinism: identical input+config+seed reproduces identical event-level observables, and any event loss is explicit.
inputs: small fixed-seed sample (e.g. N=100, exact N is an implementation choice, not fixed here)
checks: two independent runs with identical (input_lhe_sha256, config_sha256, pythia.seed, channel_selection_seed) produce identical output_file_hashes, OR an explicitly documented non-determinism source is recorded
n_events_in == n_events_out + n_events_failed_decay + n_events_filtered (accounting identity holds exactly)
no filter removes events without a logged reason
gates.acceptance_criteria: Accounting identity holds exactly; hash reproducibility holds or documented deviation is recorded.
gates.failure_status: exit 3, run marked FAILED or PROVISIONAL depending on which sub-check failed

gates.purpose: Confirm the configured lifetime is honored statistically, correctly accounting for lab-frame boost (not a naive lab-frame exponential check).
inputs: a statistically adequate sample (size set by the implementation to satisfy the acceptance tolerance below, not fixed here)
checks: reconstruct each decayed h2's proper decay length: L_proper = L_lab / (beta*gamma), using each event's own h2 momentum/energy

compare the reconstructed proper-length distribution's mean (or a likelihood/KS test against the configured exponential law with rate 1/ctau_mm) using the boost-corrected quantity, never the raw lab-frame decay distance
minimum sample size chosen so the statistical test has adequate power (implementation must justify the chosen N against the tolerance below)
gates.acceptance_criteria: Reconstructed proper decay length statistically compatible with configured ctau_mm at a pre-declared confidence level (implementation-chosen, e.g. via KS test p-value threshold, documented in the run's evidence artifact); KS test used as a diagnostic, not a pass/fail oracle in isolation.
gates.failure_status: exit 3, run marked FAILED; PROVISIONAL if sample size was below the documented minimum

gates.purpose: Confirm generated per-channel decay fractions match configured branching ratios within statistical uncertainty.
inputs: same sample as AA4, or a dedicated sufficiently large sample
checks: per-channel generated event counts recorded (per_channel_generated_count)
observed fraction per channel compared to configured branching_ratio using binomial/multinomial standard error, not a fixed arbitrary percentage tolerance
tolerance = configured_BR +/- k * sqrt(BR*(1-BR)/N) for a pre-declared k (e.g. k=3), documented per run
gates.acceptance_criteria: All channels within the statistical tolerance band for the declared k and sample size N.

gates.purpose: Confirm Pack AA does not alter Pack A's production content or normalization.
checks: per-event LHE weights unchanged between input and the corresponding output event's carried weight
sigma_LO_fb (Pack A production cross section) field unmodified anywhere in Pack AA's manifest
initial hard-process identity (g g > H > h2 h2) unchanged
number and identity of input h2 particles before decay matches the LHE exactly (no added/removed/duplicated h2 pre-decay)
gates.acceptance_criteria: All four checks pass with exact equality (no tolerance).

gates.purpose: Confirm the chosen output format is actually openable by the intended downstream reader or a minimal adapter, without performing recast validation.
inputs: a minimal reader (e.g. HepMC2 I/O test, or the llp_recast adapter's declared input path once bootstrapped)
checks: output file parses without error under a HepMC2 reader
particle/vertex counts in the parsed file match Pack AA's own internal event count
if llp_recast's frozen upstream reader is available, a smoke-open (not a cutflow run) succeeds
gates.acceptance_criteria: File opens cleanly and reports the expected event count; no recast-level cutflow or acceptance result is produced or claimed.
gates.failure_status: exit 3 if the file does not parse; PROVISIONAL if llp_recast's own reader was unavailable to test against
